title: Horseshoe Gang - Ain’t No Excuses
htmlContent: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e_QLLQNqlfc Mentored and encouraged by their elder brother KXNG Crooked, the Horseshoe Gang embodies the term “family affair, “as brothers Demetrius, Julius, Kenny and Dice formed as a group before they even reached their teen years. A vital component in the west coast hip-hop scene for close to a decade now, HSG has earned their stripes the old-fashioned way; by putting out good music that increases their substantial following with each subsequent release. That momentum continues with Dope Lyrics Matter. HSG is not a group that creates music based off of “vibes.” Rather, these brothers competitively strive to break after each other’s necks; bar for bar with each verse. The that competitive streak was put on full display a few years ago after Funk Volume (Hopsin, Dizzy Wright, Jarren Benton) appeared on Sway In The Morning and challenged to face off with any group for 500K. HSG swiftly accepted the challenge when they visited Sway which resulted in back-to-back-to-back responses from the two respective camps. Dope Lyrics Matter, represents the group’s head, both in title and content. HSG’s reputation as ruthless lyricists delivering quick-fire rhymes, hooks and vastly superior wordplay is well-established, but Dope Lyrics Matter also displays versatility in themes and concepts; with humor, madness and pathos evident throughout. Horseshoe Gang’s Dope Lyrics Matter is available for purchase and streaming on all digital platforms: https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/dope-lyrics-matter/1313085190
